label: Jingyi Jingwei 境内销售/境外销售 table
definition: Issuer source-native table from the STAR-market second-round inquiry reply (2024-01-05), comparing 境外销售收入 (net of a 综合服务费 paid to its overseas sales agent 登普半导体) against 境内销售收入, for 2020, 2021, 2022, H1 2023 and the 报告期合计 (2020-H1 2023 aggregate). TOTAL-OPERATING-REVENUE basis confirmed by residual: 境内销售收入+境外销售收入 reproduces the issuer's own 营业收入 for every period exactly (e.g. FY2022: 44,799.65+5,781.17=50,580.82万元, matching the issuer's own disclosed FY2022 营业收入 of 50,580.82万元 to the cent; FY2021, FY2020 and H1 2023 all reconcile the same way), so this is not a narrower main-business-only split. 境外销售毛利率(①) is computed by the issuer on 境外销售收入 NET OF the 综合服务费 agent commission, not on the gross 境外销售收入 also printed in the same row; dividing the gross revenue and cost cells directly will not reproduce the printed margin. 境内销售毛利率(②) uses the gross 境内销售收入/境内销售成本 directly with no such adjustment.
